title: Fourier coefficients of restricted functions
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on all coordinates outside $J$. Extend the restricted function to the whole cube using those fixed signs outside $J$ and the input signs on $J$. For any subset $S$ of $J$, the Fourier coefficient of this extension at the corresponding coordinate set $S$ equals the Fourier coefficient of the restricted function at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
A sign assignment is fixed on every coordinate outside $J$
